summary: Minimal Host premerge SHA-binding repair: GitHub PR required checks and the Host App check-run attach to the candidate head, while the actual tested merge remains independently verified by exact two-parent identity and CI artifact. Main temporarily retains the original five strict required checks; the sixth Host check is re-enabled only after a protected merge, trusted Host update, and real positive/negative signing checks.

components.owning_subsystem: Host premerge verifier and GitHub App publisher
components.disposition: modify existing authority without adding a new signer or relaxing required evidence
evidence: Verifier queries and rechecks PR Actions check-runs on candidate head SHA; it still verifies tested_merge SHA and both parents, main-pinned gate blobs, and CI artifact pr_head/pr_base/pr_merge identity.
Publisher checks and writes lfl-host-premerge on candidate head SHA, validates the App identity and response SHA, and retains signed snapshot, live Lane/Queue, and write-before-publish rechecks.
components.verification_level: Predecessor 152c38c: independent Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0, Host-managed review PASS, 112 focused tests PASS, original R9 exit 0 with disclosed FLAKY-PASS. New manifest successor SHA requires fresh exact-SHA review, full R9 and remote CI.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Model text never signs Host evidence. Missing or mismatched signed snapshot, SHA, workflow, App identity, CI artifact, or live state must HOLD; recovery is a new Host-signed snapshot and exact-SHA revalidation. Disable the sixth required check on rollback, retaining the original five strict checks.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert of this repair and trusted Host installation; preserve audit records and original five strict required checks. Do not enable the sixth check until real signing and permission-negative tests pass.

evidence: 112 focused tests passed on predecessor 152c38c, including red PR-head checks not overridden by green merge checks, wrong check-run head SHA rejection, and wrong Host publish-response SHA rejection.
components.verification_level: 112 focused tests exit 0 on predecessor; repeat on successor and in original full R9.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Not a signing authority; negative assertions must fail closed and are not substitutes for a real Host probe.
components.rollback_route: Revert together with the corresponding Host verifier and publisher changes.

evidence: Local A.5 check on predecessor 152c38c returned exit 2 because the exact changed-path set had no submission manifest; this single new manifest declares all five successor changed paths.
components.verification_level: A.5 exact changed-path coverage to be verified on successor SHA.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Declaration only, not a signature, review verdict, or exception to any required status check.
components.rollback_route: Revert with the repair; missing A.5 evidence must block the PR rather than waive the gate.

g1.necessity: GitHub PR checks were read from the tested merge SHA while GitHub attached them to the candidate head; the Host App publisher also wrote to the merge SHA. This mismatched required-check identity blocked safe integration.

g2.authority_owner: Root-owned Host verifier and trusted GitHub Host App remain the only signers; protected main owns the required-check policy.
g2.non_duplication: Reuse the existing verifier, publisher, CI artifact and signed snapshot; change only GitHub check-run attachment to PR head, not tested-merge evidence or signing authority.

model_evidence: Independent GLM-5.3-flash Reviewer on predecessor 152c38c: PASS P0=0 P1=0 P2=3; this is not an approval for the manifest successor SHA.
Host review_admission tree-scope qualification PASS on predecessor 152c38c, bound to its original candidate fingerprint; successor must be independently requalified.

Predecessor original R9 exit 0, FLAKY-PASS: first xdist run had one unrelated terminal PTY SIGTERM timeout, serial file 15 passed, then identical full xdist rerun 16179 passed; no failure is concealed.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Any P0/P1, new R9 or remote CI failure, wrong candidate/merge identity, or untrusted Host installation keeps the PR on HOLD. Re-review the exact successor SHA; never reuse predecessor qualifications.

g4.rollback: Keep main strict with its original five checks during repair; use protected revert and restore the previous root-owned Host binaries if the new verifier fails. The sixth check stays non-required until true signing and negative tests pass.
verification: A.5 exact changed-path coverage for all five successor paths must PASS.
Independent Reviewer PASS P0/P1=0 and original full R9 exit 0 on exact successor SHA; preserve FLAKY-PASS details if present.
Managed push and PR remote CI including pytest/Ruff/Pyright, security, privacy, A.5 and managed-premerge-evidence must pass before protected main merge.

After main CI, update root-owned Host verifier and publisher to the exact protected main blobs; perform real signed positive and permission/SHA negative probes before re-enabling the sixth required check and revalidating PR #86.
